name: Palmaia - The House of AiA
positioning: All-inclusive wellness resort between the jungle and the ocean at the southern point of Playa del Carmen on Mexico's Riviera Maya
best_for: Travelers who want a wellness-focused all-inclusive stay
Guests who want jungle and ocean in one secluded setting

facts.text: Palmaia sits between the jungle and the ocean on Mexico's Riviera Maya.
The resort is located on the most southern point of Playa del Carmen.
The resort is surrounded by 400 hectares of virgin jungle.
Cancun airport is about a 45-minute drive away.
The resort was deliberately built up rather than out to preserve as much of the land and natural landscape as possible.
Pathways lead through the jungle to yoga decks, cenotes and spa treatment temples.
Wildlife on the grounds includes sereques, coatis, spider monkeys, iguanas and armadillos.
All suites are free of animal products.
Palmaia uses a one-rate all-inclusive system where guests pay once.
The AiA Wellness program offers more than 50 holistic and health activities every week, led by in-house and visiting guides.
Indigenous healing at Atlantis Spa is practiced by medicine-men and women whose knowledge has often been passed down through generations.
The Nourishing Biome food program removes the most toxic ingredients of the modern food system.

highlights.text: A woven wooden tunnel leads from the rooms to the beach, and elevated walkways wind through the jungle canopy.
Atlantis Spa sits among ancient rock formations, jungle, natural cenotes and mangroves.
Spa treatments are carried out in temples integrated into the jungle.
Remnants of Mayan sacred sites still exist on the land, outside of public view.

considerations.text: There are no roads to Palmaia; guests enter a private residential development and cross a neighbouring resort by golf cart to reach it.
Spa, private dinners and private one-on-one sessions may carry extra charges.
Beginning November 1, 2026, Palmaia welcomes children aged 10 and above.
